# Orneco — Premium Facial Tissues

> Orneco Health Care Pvt. Ltd. manufactures and markets ultra-soft, 2-ply premium facial tissues and hygiene paper products thoughtfully made in Bharat for everyday care.

## Products & Specifications
- [Orneco 2-Ply Facial Tissues](https://ornecoindia.com/#details): Premium 2-ply soft tissues, 100 pulls (200 sheets), sheet size 18 × 19 cm, MRP ₹100 incl. taxes.
- [Product Specifications](https://ornecoindia.com/#details): Detailed breakdown of ply count, sheet dimensions, net quantity, and packaging.
- [Texture & Quality](https://ornecoindia.com/#about): Pure and soft virgin tissue paper gentle on all skin types and sensitive skin.

## Key Benefits & Features
- [Deep Cleaning](https://ornecoindia.com/#benefits): Highly absorbent 2-ply sheets for face cleansing, dirt and makeup removal.
- [Ultra Soft Feather Touch](https://ornecoindia.com/#benefits): Cloud-like comfort that remains gentle even with frequent daily use.
- [Everyday Reliability](https://ornecoindia.com/#why): Strong plies that do not tear easily, ideal for home, office, and car.
